title: ChaCha Diagonal Round XOR-Rotate-12 (b ^= c; b = rotl12(b))
rationale: Fuses XOR and Rotate-12 in Diagonal Round Step 6 (b ^= c; b = rotl(b, 12)). Replaces 1 XOR (1c) + Rotate-12 (3c: slli12/srli20/or) = 4 cycles with 1 cycle. Saves 3 cycles per Diagonal Round Step 6. 4 diags/round * 20 rounds = 80 executions. Saves 240 cycles/block. Highest single-instruction savings.
